A THE WORKING FLOW Given a dataset D = {(x, y l , y w )}, we equally divide it into three folds D SFT , D RM and D RL . Starting from a pre-trained language model M pre (•|•), we first conduct normal SFT and RLHF on D to obtain RLHF-finetuned model M RL P (•|•). M RL P (•|•) takes a prompt x as the input (e.g., Please give me a three-day travel plan about Los Angeles.) and return a response y. The input format of M RL P (•|x) during training and inference is: Human:{x} Assistant: , where {x} denotes the concrete input x. Then we train PIT M RL PIT (•|•, •) that takes a prompt and a candidate response as inputs and returns an improved response. The input format of M RL PIT (•|x, y ref ) is Human:{x} Assistant:<<Candidate>>{y ref }<<Improved>> , where {} denotes concrete contents and <<>> denotes a special token.
